name: Egg Rice
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 1 small (a little bit bigger than a golf ball) onion, chopped
¼ tsp spice blend (the blend ratio should be like ½ stick of cinnamon : 3 cardamon pods : 6 cloves)

steps: Cook rice and keep it aside.
Sweat onions and green chilies in a pan together over medium heat.
Add rice, and mix everything well.
Cook until everything is mixed well.
